newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat aims to up India JV stake to 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fiat aims to up India JV stake to 100 pct.

text.p: Italy's Fiat aims to buy up the 24 percent held by India's Doshi family in the joint venture that will start to produce Fiat's Palio world car towards the end of 1999.

The Turin carmaker, which hold 76 percent of the joint venture, has asked the Indian government for permission to make the purchase and is awaiting authorisation which is likely to be given, a Fiat group source said.
Under the agreements between Fiat and the Doshi family, the Indian partner will be able to buy back the 24 percent stake whenever it wished to do so.
The Doshi family controls Premier Automobiles Ltd, the company licensed to produce the Fiat Uno in India.
